items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Cool, me and Cliff had come up together... He played with us now and then I think when he was just was learning.

ctx.x: Huh? Do you remember Bobby? Oh sure. Used to call him Hard Yard. Yeah.

He was a good drummer. Yeah. He went out there to California too. You there yet? That's another, no, I heard from him. But what was he? He was a good drummer. Yeah. He went out there to California too. You there yet? He said, I don't know, I heard from him. He said, what did you see there? He said, he'd dress up feet all the time. Yeah. He was a good little drummer. He was a cheap. Every time they come on the job, he'd buy the band a pint of whiskey, a quart of whiskey. You know, whiskey was cheap then, you know.…
Boy one on his arm, one on his arm, one on his mouth, and two on his back part.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: You didn't ever say nothing about Snag, Cliff Jones. Yeah, and who did you say? Cliff Jones called him Snag. You remember, Cliff?

ctx.x: Eddie Woods. Eddie Woods? Eddie Woods is Faso's name.

Eddie Woods is Faso's name. Eddie Woods, that's his name? Right name, Faso's name? Oh, yeah. You didn't ever say nothing about Snag, Cliff Jones. Yeah, and who did you say? Cliff Jones called him Snag. You remember, Cliff? Oh, yeah. And I'll tell you another, Black Benny was about the best guy in there. You know, bass drum. Bass drum, yeah. Bass drum. You know, in a parade, bass band. But we picked him up before he got killed, put him on Snag. He was good then. But I said he got killed. Yeah, I was really pretty…
Ask him if he followed parades. You hear myself?
